models.code:
class Customer(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'customer'
    Id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    Name = Column(String)
    CreditLimit = Column(Integer)
    Balance = Column(Integer)
models.description: Model for customers with a credit limit and balance.
models.name: Customer

models.code:
class Order(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'order'
    Id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    CustomerId = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('customer.Id'))
    DateShipped = Column(DateTime, nullable=True)
    AmountTotal = Column(Integer)
    Notes = Column(String)
models.description: Model for orders with a reference to customer and a notes field.
models.name: Order

models.code:
class Item(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'item'
    Id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    OrderId = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('order.Id'))
    ProductId = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('product.Id'))
    Quantity = Column(Integer)
    Amount = Column(Integer)
    UnitPrice = Column(Integer)
models.description: Model for items linked to orders and products.
models.name: Item

models.code:
class Product(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'product'
    Id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    Name = Column(String)
    UnitPrice = Column(Integer)
models.description: Model for products with a unit price.
models.name: Product

rules.name: Rule 1
rules.description: Ensure customer's balance does not exceed their credit limit.
rules.code:
Rule.constraint(validate=Customer,
                as_condition=lambda row: row.Balance <= row.CreditLimit,
                error_msg="Customer balance ({row.Balance}) exceeds credit limit ({row.CreditLimit})")

rules.name: Rule 2
rules.description: Derive customer's balance as the sum of order amount total where date shipped is null.
rules.code: Rule.sum(derive=Customer.Balance, as_sum_of=Order.AmountTotal, where=lambda row: row.DateShipped is None)

rules.name: Rule 3
rules.description: Derive order's amount total as the sum of item amount.

rules.name: Rule 4
rules.description: Calculate item's amount as quantity multiplied by unit price.

rules.name: Rule 5
rules.description: Copy item's unit price from product.

rules.name: Rule 6
rules.description: Send order to Kafka if date shipped is not none.
rules.code:
Rule.after_flush_row_event(on_class=Order, calling=kafka_producer.send_row_to_kafka,
                           if_condition=lambda row: row.DateShipped is not None,
                           with_args={"topic": "order_shipping"})
